title: Data Engineering Lead
description:
At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!
   

  

**What We Do…**
 We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world\-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online \- quickly and simply.
   

  

 We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.
   

  

 And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 56,000 hotels in 150\+ countries \- with over 140 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.
   

  

**About The Data Engineering Lead Role…**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Data Engineering Lead to provide technical direction and people leadership for a small team of data engineers. You will help shape the evolution of SiteMinder’s cloud data platform while continuing to contribute directly to the design and delivery of data engineering solutions.
   

  

 This is a player\-coach role. You will spend approximately 70% of your time on data engineering projects and 30% on Data Operations, reliability, and support. You will work across Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, Terraform, Python, SQL, and related technologies.
   

  

 You will partner with engineering, product, finance, commercial, and analytics stakeholders to turn business needs into trusted, maintainable data solutions. You will also help establish the engineering standards, operating practices, and team capabilities needed to scale our data platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do…**
**Technical leadership**
* Set technical direction for data engineering projects and make pragmatic architecture decisions
* Lead design reviews and establish reusable patterns for ingestion, transformation, orchestration, data modelling, testing, deployment, and observability
* Promote engineering best practices across code quality, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, security, documentation, and operational readiness
* Guide the adoption and effective use of Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, AWS, and supporting platform technologies
* Identify opportunities to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, data quality, and cost efficiency
* Provide hands\-on technical contribution to complex data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and production issues


**People leadership**
* Lead, coach, and develop a small team of data engineers through regular feedback, goal\-setting, mentoring, and career development
* Support hiring, onboarding, performance management, and capability planning for the team
* Create an environment of ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement
* Help team members make sound technical decisions while encouraging autonomy and accountability


**Delivery and stakeholder partnership**
* Own or contribute to the delivery of data engineering initiatives from discovery and design through implementation and production support
* Translate business and analytical requirements into robust data products and well\-defined delivery plans
* Build strong functional knowledge of SiteMinder’s systems and business processes, including applications such as Salesforce and Zuora
* Work effectively with geographically distributed teams and communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Participate in data discovery, deep\-dive analysis, and investigation of complex data issues, communicating findings and recommended actions clearly


**Data Operations and reliability**
* Help operate and support production data pipelines, datasets, and integrations within agreed service levels.
* Establish effective monitoring, alerting, incident response, root\-cause analysis, and problem\-management practices.
* Improve data quality through automated testing, validation, reconciliation, lineage, and documentation.
* Manage operational requests and prioritise ad hoc analysis based on business impact and urgency.
* Identify recurring operational issues and convert them into sustainable engineering improvements rather than manual workarounds


**What You Have…**
**Technical Experience**
* Significant professional experience in data engineering, including experience leading technical delivery or mentoring engineers
* Strong hands\-on experience with cloud data platforms, including Databricks and/or Snowflake, and production experience with dbt
* Experience designing and implementing data platforms using medallion or comparable layered architecture patterns
* Strong Python and SQL skills, with practical experience writing, testing, debugging, and optimising production data pipelines
* Experience with data modelling, dimensional modelling, data warehousing, fact and dimension tables, slowly changing dimensions, and analytical data products
* Experience building and operating complete ETL or ELT processes, including ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring
* Practical experience with Terraform or another infrastructure\-as\-code approach
* Experience building bespoke integrations using Python, REST APIs, or similar technologies
* Strong understanding of data reliability, observability, security, access control, and cost management
* Experience working with AWS data services and the ability to choose appropriate services for a given use case


**Leadership and collaboration**
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, make clear technical decisions, and create alignment across teams
* Experience coaching engineers and raising engineering standards across a team
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder\-management skills
* A structured and analytical approach to problem\-solving, with sound judgment when working independently
* Experience working effectively with geographically distributed and culturally diverse teams
* A practical, delivery\-focused mindset suited to a growing technology organisation


**Nice to have**
* Experience with streaming or event\-driven data platforms such as Kafka, Kinesis, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with AWS services such as Glue, EMR, and Kinesis
* Experience with Spark and large\-scale distributed data processing
* Experience with change data capture, near\-real\-time ingestion, or integration with OLTP systems
* Experience with data governance, data contracts, metadata management, lineage, or master data concepts
* Experience supporting a migration between data platforms, such as Snowflake and Databricks
* Experience in the SaaS, travel, hospitality, or marketplace sectors


**Our Perks \& Benefits…**
* Mental health and well\-being initiatives
* Generous parental (including secondary) leave policy
* Flexibility to work in a Hybrid model (3 days in\-office)
* Paid birthday, study and volunteering leave every year
* Sponsored social clubs, team events, and celebrations
* Employee Resource Groups (ERG) to help you connect and get involved
* Investment in your personal growth offering training for your advancement

 When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any adjustments you may need during the interview process. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply.

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof\-of\-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.
   

  

 As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high\-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk. This role reports to the Manager, Customer Success Operations, with global reporting and technical alignment to the Director of Technical Delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.
* Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.
* Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.

It designs, implements, and supports largescale, data intensive systems that facilitate risk data management, advanced analytics, visualization, analysis, and reporting across various asset classes.
   

  

 The India Risk Technology team is a strategic part of the global organization. Team members in India participate in the full lifecycle of the risk platform development — from design and engineering through enhancement and support — and take ownership of critical systems used by risk managers and senior leadership worldwide.
   

  

 As Jefferies continues to modernize and expand its risk ecosystem, Risk Technology is building the next generation risk platform using cloud native architectures, distributed compute, containers, modern data platforms, advanced BI, and applied AI. **Job Description**
 We are seeking a hands‑on
 **Developer** 
 to build and operate risk dashboards and reports leveraging Astrato’s direct\-query connection to a Snowflake database containing all required risk and static data needed to produce the firm’s risk. The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of
 **data modeling** 
 and
 **business intelligence fundamentals \& concepts**

* Self\-starter and entrepreneurial in approach

Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

 In managing Mastercard’s Commercial and New Payment Flow databases the Senior Platform Engineer must be highly experienced in database backup and recovery, performance tuning, and high availability configuration.  Role

 The ideal candidate for this position should:
   

  

* Have strong experience in working with RDBMS and NoSQL database technologies as a DBA.

* Have strong documentation skills to contribute to Database Engineering processes and procedures.
* Recommend and implement business and process improvements to facilitate optimal performance and/or efficiencies.
* Have ability to proactively plan and coordinate larger technical efforts within the


 database team and with external technology teams.
   

  

* Have ability to contribute to Mastercard best practices in planning, coordinating, implementing, and maintaining database solutions.
* Have ability to train and mentor junior members of the team.
* Communicate, collaborate, and work effectively in a global environment.
* Have abiility to be on\-call after hours and weekends.


**Education (preferred)**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Information systems or equivalent experience.


 \*\*Desirable Knowledge/Experience\*\*
   

  

* Experience in database replication technologies e.g. Oracle Dataguard (with FSFO), Oracle GoldenGate, Postgres Distributed a plus.
* Experience working on cloud\-hosted services a plus.
* Database Technologies Include (not limited to): Oracle, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis. The ideal candidate should have experience in both RDBMS and NoSQL database technologies


**Preferred Skills**
* Exposure to Oracle databases
* Exposure to Linux operating systems
* Exposure to Oracle plsql programming


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**Company Description**
 Entain India is the engineering and delivery powerhouse for Entain, one of the world's leading global sports and gaming groups. Established in Hyderabad in 2001, we've grown from a small tech hub into a dynamic force, delivering cutting\-edge software solutions and support services that power billions of transactions for millions of users worldwide.
   

  

 Our focus on quality at scale drives us to create innovative technology that supports Entain's mission to lead the change in global sports and gaming sector. At Entain India, we make the impossible possible, together.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an SDE III, you'll bring your engineering depth into a new way of working. You won't just write code — you'll specify, orchestrate, validate, and ship with AI as your primary collaborator. You'll work in a small, mission\-driven cross\-functional team called a pod — three functions (Product, Engineer, Quality) with high agency, shared ownership, and no hand\-offs.
   

  

 Reporting to the Tech Lead, you'll join the Product \& Technology Team. Are you ready to be part of a team that's redefining how software gets built in an AI Native setup?
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Deliver against the pod's mission — own the full software delivery lifecycle including quality, from design through production and measurement.
* Operate in continuous flow (Kanban) — pull work, respect WIP limits, ship daily.
* Use AI agents as your primary delivery mechanism — code generation, testing, spec writing, deployment.
* Design, build, and debug software across backend and frontend with distributed systems awareness.
* Evaluate and tune agent workflows — steering docs, prompts, rules, skills. You improve the tools you use.
* Write clean, well\-tested code and take ownership of quality end\-to\-end.
* Act as the initial on\-call responder, ensuring health and stability of deployed applications.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to shared tooling, knowledge bases, and the agent foundation kit.


 Engineering Mindset — What We Look For
   

  

**We Assess Every Candidate Across Six Core Dimensions**
* AI Fluency: AI is the primary way we engineer. Prompt, evaluate, and iterate. Manual coding is a deliberate choice, not the default.
* Cross\-Functional Versatility: “That’s not my area” doesn’t exist. Contribute beyond your discipline, share knowledge openly, and communicate clearly across different formats.
* Customer and Value Awareness: Ask “why” and “for whom” before “how.” Understand the bigger business context while still being able to zoom in and trace a bug. Map dependencies before you build.
* Craft: Apply SOLID principles, DRY, separation of concerns, and observability by default. Write clean, maintainable code with the right level of testing. Treat CI/CD as standard engineering practice, whether the code is written by a human or an AI agent.
* Technical Curiosity: Build a prototype, experiment, and try to break it before relying solely on documentation. Stay curious about how things work and continuously explore better approaches.
* Agency \& Entrepreneurship: Don’t wait for permission. Take ownership of outcomes end\-to\-end, enable others to succeed, challenge the status quo, and proactively look for ways to create value.


**Qualifications**
* Strong proficiency in at least one of the following: Java/Spring Boot, Python, .NET, Go, or Angular, with the ability to learn and work with other technologies using AI.
* Strong foundation in engineering fundamentals, including distributed systems, data structures, API design, database concepts, and cloud computing.
* Experience with clean code practices, TDD, CI/CD, and version control.
* Experience with application monitoring, observability, and production debugging.
* Familiarity with Docker/Kubernetes, microservices, and event\-driven architectures.
* Proficiency in using AI\-assisted development tools for code generation, pair programming, and automated testing.
* Experience with agent systems, MCP/tool protocols, or building AI\-augmented workflows.
* Experience designing evaluation and observability strategies for AI\-generated outputs.


**Nice to Have**
* Contributions to shared tooling, internal platforms, or open\-source projects.
* Background in industries with strict regulatory requirements, such as gaming, financial services, or healthcare.


**Additional Information**

* Safe home pickup and home drop.

title: Solutions Architecture - Advisor II
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Solutions Architecture \- Advisor II
   

  

**About Your Role**
 You will join Fiserv’s AI Engineering Productivity team, which builds internal platforms and tools that apply AI to improve how software is designed, developed, tested, deployed, and operated across the enterprise. In this role, you will define the end\-to\-end architecture for AI\-powered developer tooling and agentic platforms, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, auditable, and aligned with the needs of a regulated financial services environment. You will work across engineering, infrastructure, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to turn AI productivity goals into practical platform capabilities and standards.

* Establish technical vision, reference architectures, architectural standards, and architecture decision records to guide engineering delivery.
* Design LLM\-based and agentic systems, including model selection, retrieval\-augmented generation, tool and function calling, orchestration patterns, evaluation approaches, and guardrail controls.

* Evaluate AI models, frameworks, vendors, and platform integration patterns to support enterprise adoption and long\-term maintainability.
* Review solution designs and implementation approaches to ensure engineering execution remains aligned to architecture standards and intended outcomes.
* Prototype and validate architecture patterns using AI tooling and development frameworks to accelerate delivery and establish practical usage standards for teams.
* Partner with business, engineering, security, compliance, and infrastructure stakeholders to align solutions with enterprise priorities and constraints.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.


**Experience You’ll Need To Have**
* 6\+ years of experience in solution architecture across application, data, integration, and infrastructure domains.
* 6\+ years of experience in cloud\-native architecture using AWS, Azure, or GCP, including microservices, APIs, containers, and distributed systems.
* 6\+ years of experience in designing AI and LLM\-based systems using retrieval\-augmented generation, orchestration workflows, tool calling, model evaluation, and guardrail patterns.
* 6\+ years of experience in secure architecture practices including identity and access management, data protection, audit logging, and privacy controls in regulated environments.
* 6\+ years of experience in defining non\-functional architecture requirements including scalability, resilience, latency, observability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* 6\+ years of experience in documenting architecture standards, reference architectures, and architecture decision records for engineering teams.
* 6\+ years of experience in prototyping and validating designs using Python, TypeScript, Java, or Go in enterprise software environments.
* 6\+ years of equivalent combination of educational background, related experience, and/or military experience


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience with financial services platforms supporting payments, settlement, ledgers, risk, compliance, or regulatory reporting.
* Experience with MLOps or LLMOps practices, including model deployment, monitoring, prompt versioning, and regression testing.
* Experience with multi\-agent orchestration frameworks and enterprise tool ecosystem integration.
* TOGAF, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud architecture certification.
* Experience presenting architectural trade\-offs and governance decisions to senior technology and business stakeholders.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.
   

  

**Warning About Fake Job Posts**
 Please be aware of fraudulent job postings that are not affiliated with Fiserv. Fraudulent job postings may be used by cyber criminals to target your personally identifiable information and/or to steal money or financial information. Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

**About Azodha** 




 Healthcare is moving out of hospitals—into homes, virtual care, and distributed models. The technology to run this shift doesn't really exist yet. Azodha is solving that. We sit on top of existing systems and coordinate what actually makes care delivery work—people, workflows, logistics, and data—in real time. The result is a single system that replaces fragmented tools and manual coordination. We're not another point solution. We're building the operating layer for decentralized care.

 You'll be building backend systems used directly by clinicians and care teams—where scheduling, coordination, and data exchange need to work reliably across fragmented systems. This isn't just about writing clean code. You'll own features end\-to\-end, make real infrastructure decisions, and work closely with the founder/CEO to shape both the product and the engineering culture.

* Backend architecture and data infrastructure across the platform

* The way care delivery scales in decentralized, distributed environments



  





**Why this is worth your time**

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
****Role Overview****
 We are transitioning our organization to an AI\-first operational model. We are seeking an
 **AI Product Engineer** 
 to architect and build the company’s central intelligence engine.
   

  

 In this role, you will be the primary builder of
 **automated intelligence systems** 
 —tools that not only retrieve insights but actively trigger workflows, and synthesize strategic intel across our entire business landscape.
   

  

****Role Profile****
 This is a high\-impact, hands\-on engineering role requiring a convergence of three distinct skill sets:
   

  

* Software Engineering (50%): Building scalable middleware, API integrations, and production\-grade applications that connect our data stack to business tools (CRM, Marketing Automation, Support/Ticketing).


* AI Engineering (30%): Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Building the "Enterprise Brain" (Architecture \& Integration)

* AI Logic \& Agent Implementation
* Architect "Agentic" workflows where LLMs are granted permission to perform tasks

description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title:** 
**Senior Data Platform Engineer**
**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Role Description**
* This position sits within Deutsche Bank's eDiscovery and Archiving Technology group and will play a leading engineering role in the modernization of a critical enterprise data platform. The platform provides identification, data\-source intelligence, and configuration\-control capabilities supporting defensible eDiscovery decisions across Legal, Compliance, HR, Audit, and Investigations. The successful candidate will strengthen and evolve the existing on\-premise data platform while leading the technical design and hands\-on development of a new generation GCP\-based data platform. This is a deeply hands\-on engineering role, not a pure architecture, coordination, or people\-management position. It requires expert\-level Java engineering, strong data\-platform design capability, practical Python coding knowledge, and the ability to convert complex legacy business logic into modular, testable, observable, and auditable services and data products. The role will set engineering direction, lead designs, influence technical team members through code\-level credibility, and remain directly accountable for coding, code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and production delivery.


**What We’ll Offer You**
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,
   

  

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Operate as a deeply hands\-on lead engineer: personally design, code, unit test, review, profile, debug, deploy, and support production\-grade Oracle PL/SQL packages, Java services, APIs, batch components, data\-processing modules, and integration frameworks. Produce reference implementations for complex or high\-risk capabilities.
* Own key design decisions for modular decomposition of legacy data\-platform capabilities, including custodian identity, employment history and aliases, application and data\-source coverage, archive configurations, retention context, refinement rules, and identification outputs.
* Extract and rationalize business logic embedded in legacy code, database routines, manual backend processes, and operational knowledge; distinguish essential control logic from accidental complexity and prevent a like\-for\-like migration of legacy constraints.
* Design, develop \& maintain the on\-premise data platform through substantial hands\-on Java coding, supported by relational data models, advanced SQL and PL/SQL, controlled interfaces, automated ingestion, reconciliation, and operational tooling. Improve maintainability, test coverage, documentation, release quality, and production supportability through direct implementation.
* Design for coexistence and transition between on\-premise and GCP components, including secure connectivity, data synchronization, reconciliation, dual\-run controls, cutover, rollback, and progressive retirement of legacy components without disrupting eDiscovery obligations.
* Develop scalable ingestion and onboarding patterns for HR, application, archive, account, migration, retention, and other source data; support bulk loads, schema validation, data\-quality controls, source traceability, and controlled schema evolution.
* Establish a trusted data model and source\-of\-truth hierarchy for custodian identity and source coverage, with explicit provenance, effective dating, confidence, exception handling, and full traceability of why an identification or downstream task was produced.
* Design services and configuration capabilities that reduce hard\-coded change, enable controlled onboarding and offboarding of applications and data sources, and expose reusable capabilities to EDI and other approved consumers through secure APIs and events.
* Build end\-to\-end auditability into the platform, capturing data lineage, rule versions, decision context, user and system actions, overrides, approvals, and evidence needed to explain and defend identification outcomes.
* Define engineering standards for Java, Python, SQL, APIs, data modeling, testing, observability, resilience, security, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code; use code reviews and design reviews to drive consistent adoption across the team.
* Lead technical design forums and influence engineers, architects, product partners, and control stakeholders toward robust, simple, and supportable solutions; challenge weak designs constructively and translate target architecture into implementable increments.
* Influence and coach technical team members through pair programming, hands\-on design walkthroughs, reference implementations, and detailed code reviews while holding a high bar for correctness, readability, automated testing, performance, resilience, and operational readiness.
* Implement comprehensive observability across services and pipelines, including data\-quality metrics, usage and health monitoring, structured logging, tracing, alerting, reconciliation, failure recovery, and actionable operational dashboards.
* Lead performance engineering and root\-cause analysis across Java services, databases, data pipelines, and integrations, including JVM behavior, concurrency, memory, SQL execution plans, indexing, throughput, latency, and batch\-window optimization.
* Partner with Architecture, Information Security, Data Governance, Compliance, and operations teams to ensure designs meet requirements for access control, encryption, retention, residency, resilience, disaster recovery, change governance, and production evidence.
* Drive incremental delivery through proofs of concept, walking skeletons, reusable platform components, automated tests, and measurable migration outcomes rather than producing architecture artifacts without executable implementation.


**Your Skills And Experience**
* Strong relational database engineering and advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, analytical functions, execution plan analysis, indexing, data modeling, stored procedures, and performance tuning; strong PL/SQL knowledge is highly desirable.
* Hands\-on Java expertise, including modern Java, object\-oriented and functional design, collections, concurrency, JVM internals, memory and performance tuning, exception handling, dependency management, and production debugging.
* Good practical Python coding knowledge for data processing, automation, validation, orchestration, utilities, and integration, with the ability to review Python design and code quality even though Java is the primary engineering skill.
* Strong experience building enterprise platforms, REST APIs, microservices, batch processing, event\-driven integration, persistence frameworks, security controls, and automated testing.
* Proven ability to lead complex technical designs and influence experienced engineers through clear architecture reasoning, code\-level credibility, constructive challenge, and practical implementation guidance.
* Strong data\-platform engineering experience across both on\-premise and cloud environments, including ingestion, transformation, data quality, reconciliation, metadata, lineage, effective\-dated data, and governed publication of trusted datasets.
* Hands\-on GCP data\-platform experience with BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run and/or GKE, together with sound judgment on when each service is appropriate.
* Experience re\-architecting or modernizing a legacy, business\-critical application through phased decomposition, coexistence, migration, dual run, reconciliation, and controlled cutover rather than a single high\-risk rewrite.
* Strong API\-first and metadata\-driven design capability, including service contracts, versioning, idempotency, schema evolution, backward compatibility, error models, and secure system integration.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling for identity, configuration, historical and relationship data, including normalization, dimensional or analytical models where appropriate, provenance, effective dating, and source\-of\-truth rules.
* Experience designing high\-quality automated tests, including unit, component, integration, contract, data reconciliation, regression, performance, and failure\-recovery testing, with testability designed into the platform.
* Strong DevSecOps experience using Git, CI/CD, code\-quality and security scanning, artifact management, containerization, Terraform, configuration management, secrets management, and repeatable environment promotion.
* Experience designing observable and resilient services with structured logging, metrics, traces, health checks, retries, deadletter handling, restartability, high availability, disaster recovery, and meaningful service\-level indicators.
* Ability to work in a regulated enterprise and translate security, privacy, data residency, retention, audit, and change\-control requirements into enforceable technical designs and code.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present design options and trade\-offs, build technical consensus, document decisions, and maintain focus on measurable business and control outcomes.
* A strong ownership mindset and sustained appetite for coding: comfortable moving repeatedly between architecture, Java implementation, Python utilities, SQL analysis, production troubleshooting, mentoring, stakeholder discussion, and delivery planning to remove ambiguity and drive outcomes.


 Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
   

  

**How We’ll Support You**
* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.


**About Us And Our Teams**
 Please visit our company website for further information:
   

  

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**
 We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
   

  

 Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Principal Engineer – Application Architect
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal Engineer – Application Architect
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 Payments Network Technology is seeking a Principal Engineer to provide technical and delivery leadership across payment\-network initiatives. This role will connect architecture, release coordination, dependency management, and engineering execution across multiple teams.
   

  

 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

* Define and evolve architecture for secure, scalable, and highly available payment\-network services.
* Coordinate technical delivery across teams, including releases, dependencies, defect triage, and resolution of cross\-cutting issues.
* Partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business needs into architecture and implementation direction.
* Lead design reviews and drive decisions on APIs, service interactions, data, resiliency, security, and operational readiness.
* Identify reuse opportunities and promote common engineering patterns and standards.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams.
* Communicate architecture trade\-offs, delivery risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams.


**Essential Skills**
* Extensive software architecture and development experience in large\-scale systems.
* Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, messaging, event\-driven architecture, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience with secure engineering, DevOps, performance, resiliency, observability, and production\-readiness practices.
* Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.


**All About You**
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle.
* Clear communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams.
* Experience leading SOAR (Solution Architecture Review) and driving technical strategy, architecture alignment, engineering excellence, and risk management across multiple teams.
* Experience creating and reviewing TADs (Technical Architecture Documents) for large\-scale distributed systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, resiliency objectives, and long\-term maintainability.
* Demonstrated experience defining and governing cross\-platform architecture, enabling interoperability, reuse, standardization, and consistent engineering practices across multiple products and services.
* Experience designing and implementing multi\-region resiliency architectures, including active\-active and active\-passive deployment patterns, disaster recovery strategies, cross\-region data replication, failover mechanisms, and business continuity solutions.
* Strong understanding of distributed data management, including data replication, consistency models, recovery objectives, and operational considerations across geographic regions.
* Champions operability and maintainability as first\-class design principles, ensuring observability, monitoring, automation, self\-healing capabilities, supportability, and simplified operational management are built into solutions from inception.
* Deep understanding of Mastercard Engineering Principles (or equivalent large\-scale enterprise engineering standards) and a proven ability to apply them consistently across architecture, software design, deployment, resiliency, security, and operational practices.
* Demonstrated ability to balance architecture, business priorities, scalability, security, resiliency, and operational considerations while establishing technology direction for multiple engineering teams.
* Experience defining architecture guardrails, engineering standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness across the organization.
* Strong knowledge of reliability engineering practices, including service\-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, observability, fault isolation, disaster recovery testing, and continuous resilience validation.
* Payments or financial\-services domain knowledge is preferred.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: QA Engg - Backend Automation
description:
**Corporate Overview** 
  

  


**Powering Performance Marketplaces in Digital Media** 




 QuinStreet is a pioneer in powering decentralized online 
 **marketplaces that match searchers and “research and compare” consumers with brands** 
 . We run these virtual\- and private\-label marketplaces in one of the nation’s largest media networks.
 



 Our industry leading segmentation and AI\-driven 
 **matching technologies help consumers find better solutions and brands faster.** 
  They allow brands to target and reach in\-market customer prospects with pinpoint segment\-by\-segment accuracy, and to pay only for performance results.
 



 Our campaign\-results\-driven matching decision engines and optimization algorithms are built from over 20 years and billions of dollars of online media experience.
 



 We believe in:
 


* The direct measurability of digital media.
* Performance marketing. (We pioneered it.)
* The advantages of technology.



 We bring all this together to deliver truly great results for consumers and brands in the world’s biggest channel.
 



  
 



**Quality Engineer – Backend Automation** 




**Location:** 
 Pune, India (Hybrid)
   

**Experience:** 
 4–7 Years \| 
 



**About the Role** 




 We are seeking hands\-on Quality Engineers to support the modernization of Quest, a high\-volume event and workflow\-processing platform. This role focuses on backend quality engineering, including API, event\-driven, database, integration, performance, and migration testing to ensure reliability and correctness throughout the Quest v2 migration.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and execute test strategies for backend services, APIs, event\-driven workflows, and database interactions.
* Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Java, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Validate Kafka\-based event processing, retries, ordering, duplicate handling, replay, and idempotency scenarios.
* Perform migration validation between Quest v1 and Quest v2, including reconciliation and data consistency checks.
* Develop SQL\-based data validation, integration, regression, performance, and resilience tests.
* Investigate defects using logs, metrics, traces, databases, and event streams.
* Support production deployments, release validation, and incident investigations.



**Required Skills** 



* 4–7 years of Quality Engineering, SDET, or software testing experience.
* Strong Java programming and test automation skills.
* Hands\-on experience with REST API testing, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, and CI/CD integration.
* Strong SQL and database validation experience (MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, etc.).
* Experience testing backend services, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Good understanding of HTTP, REST, JSON, Git, and Linux/Unix environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with Kafka, event\-driven systems, and distributed architectures.
* Knowledge of Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Testcontainers, WireMock, and contract testing.
* Experience with JMeter, Gatling, k6, or similar performance testing tools.
* Exposure to resilience, concurrency, recovery, and high\-volume transaction systems.



**What We're Looking For** 



* Engineers who treat automation as production\-quality software.
* Strong focus on backend, data, event\-processing, and system reliability testing.
* Ability to independently own test coverage, defect investigation, and quality validation.
* Strong collaboration skills with developers, architects, and QA teams.



**Levels:** 
 Candidates may be hired as
 **Quality Engineer (4–6 years)** 
 or
 **Senior Quality Engineer (5–7 years)** 
 based on experience and capability in automation design, test strategy, performance testing, and technical leadership.
 



  
 



 QuinStreet is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, pregnancy status, sex, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristics protected by law.
